title: (RHSA-2025:7696) Important: Red Hat Build of Apache Camel 4.10.3 for Spring Boot release, security update.
portal_summary:
Red Hat build of Apache Camel 4.10.3 for Spring Boot release and security update
is now available.

Red Hat Product Security has rated this update as having a security impact of
Important. A Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) base score, which gives
a detailed severity rating, is available for each vulnerability from the CVE
link(s) in the References section.
portal_synopsis: Important: Red Hat Build of Apache Camel 4.10.3 for Spring Boot release, security update.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Integration - Camel for Spring Boot|Red Hat Integration - Camel for Spring Boot|1|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
Red Hat build of Apache Camel 4.8.3 for Spring Boot release and security update
is now available.

The purpose of this text-only errata is to inform you about the security issues
fixed.

Security Fix(es):
   
* jetty-http2-common: Jetty HTTP/2 Header List Size Vulnerability (CVE-2025-1948)
